name: insufficient-credits
description: Recorded 2026-10-28, new in the vendor's v1.9.0 release: a real agent key drained to a 0 balance (see fixtures/balance-bound.json for the prior call that reached 0), then asked for 5 more funds. Unlike the balance-bound case (balance partially covers the page), a ZERO balance refuses outright: a real HTTP 402 — this connector's non-MCP-transport posture (plain JSON over HTTP, no SSE Accept header) gets the real transport status rather than an isError:true MCP result, per the vendor's own isMcpTransport split. error_reason 'insufficient_credits', nothing_charged true. The provider's lifecycle.start already relays any non-2xx untouched (its very first branch), so no code change was needed for this case — only this fixture and test to lock it in. Verbatim, no trimming needed.

error.message: Insufficient credits. You have 0 credits. This operation requires 5 credits. Short by 5. Top up: https://fundmomentum.vc/pricing. Nothing was charged.
